message.content: A magazine cover for "TEMPO" dated "9-15 FEBRUARI 2015" features a large, stylized illustration of a man's face against a dark brown background. The man has brown skin, dark hair, and wears black-rimmed spectacles. His mouth is wide open, revealing two rows of large, white teeth and a pink tongue. Inside the dark cavity of his mouth, a smaller, circular face of another smiling man is visible. The large face shows wide, white eyes looking upward. The main text on the left reads "DUO PENGGANJAL KPK" in large white capital letters. Below this, smaller text asks, "Benarkah ada pertemuan Hasto Kristiyanto, Hendropriyono, dan penyidik polisi perihal kriminalisasi pemimpin KPK?" Top headlines include "DAGELAN KASUS LABORA SITORUS," "DI BALIK PENEMBAKAN AKTIVIS BANGKALAN," and "DEAL POLITIK JOKOWI-PRABOWO." The bottom right corner displays "RP 39.500," the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO," and a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00050." A red border frames the left and bottom edges.
